args.body: The committed item-4-release-binding.json and operator-handoff.md agree that the exact item 4 draft matches the live offer, independent of the unpublished revision. Use the existing NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT decision and the existing operator handoff as the single place for a send-or-decline decision. Reuse any prior redacted operator decision. The exact draft hash is b1fe208d0198d03a55a01641c6d9d8e3fa269296167f53400a35594bd79ba012. Only an explicitly authorized operator may send it on the approved channel. Resume acquisition measurement on a redacted send or eligible reply receipt, and keep acceptance and settlement separate.

description: The catalogue pilot draft matches the captured live offer and can reach an operator decision without waiting for the revised site. The outstanding prerequisite for sending is authorization for the exact draft and channel. Feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains inconclusive. Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The welfare baseline sets its checkpoint at November 20, 17:00 UTC and retirement after December 4, 17:00 UTC. A separate buyer-route trial will test whether an explicit fixed-scope purchase can support a deliverable and an authorized response.
